title: ExclaveFL: Verifiable Claims for Federated Learning using Exclaves
abstract: arXiv:2412.10537v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In federated learning (FL), data providers jointly train a machine learning model without sharing training data. This makes it challenging to provide verifiable claims about the trained model, e.g., related to the employed training data, data sanitization, or training algorithm---a malicious data provider can simply deviate from the correct training protocol without detection. Prior FL training systems have used trusted execution environments (TEEs) to protect the training computation, relying on the confidentiality and integrity of TEEs. TEE confidentiality, however, has been shown to be vulnerable to various attacks, e.g., via side channels.   We describe ExclaveFL, a system for training FL models that establishes verifiable claims about models through fine-grained runtime attestation proofs. translated_title: ExclaveFL：使用隔离执行环境为联邦学习提供可验证声明
translated_abstract: 在联邦学习（FL）中，数据提供者可以在不共享训练数据的情况下共同训练机器学习模型。这使得对训练后的模型提供可验证声明变得具有挑战性，例如与所使用的训练数据、数据清洗或训练算法相关的声明——恶意数据提供者可以轻易偏离正确的训练协议而不被发现。先前的联邦学习训练系统使用可信执行环境（TEE）来保护训练计算，依赖于TEE的机密性和完整性。然而，TEE的机密性已被证明容易受到各种攻击，例如通过侧信道进行的攻击。我们提出了ExclaveFL，一个用于训练联邦学习模型的系统，它通过细粒度的运行时证明为模型建立可验证声明。由于此类证明仅需要完整性保证，ExclaveFL使用隔离执行环境来生成这些证明，这是一种仅保证完整性的执行环境……
tldr: ExclaveFL利用仅需完整性保证的隔离执行环境生成细粒度运行时证明，为联邦学习模型提供不依赖TEE机密性的可验证声明，从而避免了侧信道攻击的威胁。
en_tdlr: ExclaveFL establishes verifiable claims for federated learning models through fine-grained runtime attestation proofs generated by integrity-only exclaves, avoiding reliance on the confidentiality of trusted execution environments.
